title: A module retract of a flat module is flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $M$ and $N$ be $R$-modules, and let $i:N\to M$ and $r:M\to N$ be $R$-linear maps with $r\circ i=\operatorname{id}_N$. If $M$ is a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $N$ is a flat $R$-module.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07NP (lemma-formally-smooth-flat), final sentence
